invariants.rationale: The rectangle width should be non-negative for a valid rectangle to be scrolled into view.
The rectangle height should be non-negative for a valid rectangle to be scrolled into view.
The x-coordinate should be non-negative within the actor's coordinate system.
The y-coordinate should be non-negative within the actor's coordinate system.
A rectangle should either have zero area or both positive width and height to make sense for scrolling into view.
